snippet.title: ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies - Features & Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
There’s just two weeks until ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies launches on PC! Wishlist today: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2863680/view/531001397838087519

To prime you for your time in Portofiro, our new Features Trailer takes a look at how Skills, Conditioning, Dramatic Encounters play out in-game, coming together to form our psychedelic espionage RPG.

ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies launches May 21st 2026 on Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG.

Play with full English voice-over and text localisation in four languages: German, Spanish (Latin America), Chinese (Simplified) and Russian, with eight additional languages to be added in future free updates.

Wishlist now to be notified: https://tr.ee/wishlistzeroparades

The game releases on PlayStation®5 (PS5®) later this year.
